mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `objective_submission` (user_id, question_id, answer, correct, score) VALUES (#{userId}, #{questionId}, #{answer}, #{correct}, #{score})
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT question_id FROM `objective_submission` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND correct = 1

SELECT s.id AS submissionId, s.question_id AS questionId, q.content AS questionContent, q.type AS type, s.answer AS answer, s.correct AS correct, q.answer AS correctAnswer, s.score AS score, q.score AS fullScore, s.created_at AS createdAt FROM `objective_submission` s LEFT JOIN `objective_question` q ON q.id = s.question_id
ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{size}
